authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10816 retra gives Kumaoni reto, Gujarati ret/retī and Old Marwari reta sand. Survey retu/reto/rethi fits that sand family, with aspiration in rethi retained as an unresolved phonetic detail. Turner notes the limited evidence for the reconstructed tr cluster. Exact survey form rethi is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12918 saṃdhyā gives Gujarati sā̃j and Marathi sā̃j(h) evening. Nimadi sānjā and Bhil hānj are compared jointly in that evening family; initial h in the Bhil forms is a working regional s/h correspondence. The combined evening/afternoon survey gloss is preserved. Exact survey form hānj is preserved.
